final_decisions_required.question: Wordmark treatment: the website's lockup (mark + 'NavisLabs', mixed case, tight tracking) or a cinematic all-caps 'NAVISLABS' (≈930 px wide at 120 px, tracking 0.22 em)?
final_decisions_required.recommendation: Use the website lockup style ('NavisLabs', Geist Sans semibold) so the film and navislabs.in read as one brand; all caps only if you want a deliberately cinematic mark.

final_decisions_required.question: Keep the Navis-blue line (#1976FE, from the logo's arcs) even though the website's system has no brand colour and the apps use graphite (website/developer) and indigo (application)?
final_decisions_required.recommendation: Keep it as the film's single accent, only on the line and logo — it is the mark's own colour; never tint product UI.

final_decisions_required.question: Logomark: wait for the vector redraw (A01) or use navis-logo.png (256 px, black ground) as an interim on the dark scenes?
final_decisions_required.recommendation: Commission the vector now; use the PNG only for review cuts (its black tile will not match the ink ground).

final_decisions_required.question: Reveal copy: show 'ONE CORE · TWO PRODUCTS' (published on navislabs.in) at S05, 'TWO WAYS IN' (unapproved), or only the product names?
final_decisions_required.recommendation: Product names under AGENTS / PEOPLE; add 'ONE CORE · TWO PRODUCTS' only if it fits under one-line-at-a-time.

final_decisions_required.question: Spoken product names in L12 and L18: 'Navis Developer' / 'Navis Application' (longer, clearer) or keep the shorthand 'Navis' (the real UI's own name)?
final_decisions_required.recommendation: Name the products in VO — the brief allows 'Navis' only where the real UI shows it.

final_decisions_required.question: Approve VO tightening for L10 and L13 (and L15 'morning')?
final_decisions_required.recommendation: Yes — the founder's natural pace needs ~0.5–1 s more than these windows allow.

final_decisions_required.question: Keep DRIVE in the S15 input labels (metadata only, never demonstrated)?
final_decisions_required.recommendation: Keep only if Drive metadata appears in the real R05 payload; otherwise show GMAIL · CALENDAR.

final_decisions_required.question: Seed Marlow Health with its own demo mail so R06 shows Marlow's facts (strong isolation proof) rather than an empty result?
Website/audit conflict: navislabs.in lists Slack as a connector, the audit says no org can connect it. The film excludes Slack — confirm.
final_decisions_required.recommendation: Exclude from the film; fix the site separately.

final_decisions_required.question: Keep the 17 packages installed via Remotion Studio at 10:29 (Lambda, Cloud Run, GSAP, Lottie, whisper, transformers…), or remove them? The film does not use them.
final_decisions_required.recommendation: Remove unless you installed them on purpose (they add ~435 packages); @remotion/whisper-web or install-whisper-cpp could later serve VO forced alignment.
